items.title: One type of physical activity is linked to a 20% higher dementia risk
items.snippet: A massive study has revealed that exercising for pleasure and performing physical labor at work may have surprisingly different implications for brain health. While recreational exercise was linked to a 24% lower dementia risk, physically demanding work was associated with a 20% higher risk, suggesting that the context of movement matters.
